description: [forged] Offline structural validator for a Kenyan KRA PIN (tax identification number). Normalizes input (uppercase, strips spaces/dashes) and checks it matches ^[A-Z]\d{9}[A-Z]$ (leading taxpayer-type letter, 9 digits, trailing check letter). Does not verify the checksum, as KRA's algorithm is unpublished. (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))
